Context: a client in the sector Real-estate developer, under a confidentiality agreement. The client, people and systems are not named; this page shows the sector, my role, the measured scale and the kinds of problems, inferred from the git history of the sources ([commitů](@/glossary/commit.md)).

My role (declared by me):

- **Architect**: Designed the system and its data model, and set the rules it is built and checked by.
- **Lead engineer**: Led the engineering: wrote much of the code, reviewed the rest and kept it shipping.
- **AI engineer**: Built the AI parts: models, agents, prompts and the evaluations that keep them honest.
- **Data engineer**: Built the connectors, pipelines and stores the evidence flows through.

Period (measured): from April 2026 to November 2026; number of months with measured commits: 8.

What was delivered, by the strongest inferred capabilities (an inference from commits, paths and headings, not a measured outcome):

- [LLM agents](@/skills/llm-agents.md): Agents on large language models that plan, call tools and hand their work over with proof, under one policy.
- [Decision support](@/skills/decision-support.md): Reports, dashboards and one-page briefs that turn the evidence into a decision for the people who sign it.
- [AI transformation](@/skills/ai-transformation.md): An AI transformation programme: where AI helps, the doctrine and governance it works under, and the roadmap that delivers it.
- [Audit trail](@/skills/audit-trail.md): Evidence and provenance kept for every step, with gates that refuse a silent loss, so a reviewer can retrace the work.
